notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content: The score achievements 4 and 5 would have taken potentially thousands of hours to achieve, so after some community feedback (thanks random person still playing!), we moved those targets down substantially.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268931/e3ea063b9984cb7f2f62552789b2e5436ce8a900.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Thanks to all of you who supported us on launch week! Some of you have been helping us catch some launch day woes, and Greyson managed to patch some of these up recently. More fixes are incoming, so in the meantime continue letting us know in the Forums what you come across! And if you haven't already, leaving a review is always appreciated. :)

[h1]Fixes and Features[/h1]

- Fixed a bug that made getting to level 3 impossible (hoo boy!)
- Fixed UI scaling for high resolution screens.
- Began implementing a back-end build-pushing doohickey that will allow us to push new fixes and changes more quickly and efficiently.
